body.x: CHOISTECHNOLOGY Co., Ltd (CEO Soonpil Choi) announced that it has secured more than USD 8 billion in export consulting value for its non-invasive, wireless continuous temperature measurement technology, showcased at CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and tech exhibition held in Las Vegas early last month.

CHOISTECHNOLOGY is a domestic company that has built expertise in the IoMT (Internet of Medical Things) field since its establishment in 2001. The company explains that it has proprietary technology and numerous domestic and international patents in core body temperature algorithms, wearable sensors, and wireless communication, and develops and supplies precise, reliable solutions based on extensive clinical development experience.

Thermosafer XST600 (hereinafter, XST600) is a representative product that combines these technologies. It features a wireless, continuous core body temperature monitoring function that is easy to use in medical settings such as operating rooms, recovery rooms, and intensive care units, as well as at home.

XST600 is a non-invasive solution that measures heat flux and, using a proprietary algorithm, calculates core body temperature with high accuracy. Unlike existing intermittent temperature measurement methods or invasive catheter thermometers, it minimizes patient burden while enabling real-time tracking of temperature trends.

In addition, the structure separating the main body and the sensor, and the use of magnetic disposable probes, provide advantages for infection control and reduce both consumable costs and maintenance burdens. Furthermore, wireless communication via Bluetooth and a design optimized for hospital environments significantly reduces radio interference between medical devices, and the system supports data integration with hospital EMR systems.

body.cap: Thermosafer XST600 | Image provided by CHOISTECHNOLOGY

body.x: While CHOISTECHNOLOGY pursues FDA certification and entry into the US market, starting with XST600, it successfully gained the attention of many local medical industry officials during the exhibition, as the product won a CES 2026 Innovation Award. Driven by this momentum, the company achieved remarkable results, attracting 15 consultations at the CES 2026 site and totaling export consultation value of USD 5.71 million (approximately 8.342 billion KRW).

CHOISTECHNOLOGY explained, “The innovative temperature monitoring solution revealed at this CES created a great sensation in the global market.” They added, “Obtaining significant interest from major medical device distributors in North America and other regions through in-depth consultations during the exhibition was a major achievement, and we will pursue full-scale commercialization with the network and insights gained.”

They continued, “We also gained confidence that our solutions, which boast high utility and reliability across healthcare, can serve as core infrastructure for future medical and healthcare environments.” They stated, “Our goal is to actively reflect feedback from global buyers discussed during consultations to strengthen a lineup customized for the North American market and link this to visible export results within the year.”

body.x: Incheon Metropolitan City and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority announced that they will establish the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion in the LVCC North Hall at CES 2026, showcasing Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as the city evolves from smart city development into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs—including the 10 companies participating in the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion, Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Award Showcase—the organizations will support the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES. Notably, 14 companies received CES Innovation Awards across 17 categories, marking a record-high achievement and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovation companies.
